topic: Designing a scientific investigation on formation of a new substance
key_concepts: A scientific investigation begins with clear objectives
A hypothesis is a testable statement based on the objectives
Materials and equipment must be listed to test the hypothesis
Procedures are written as ordered steps
Observations are recorded in a titled data table
Discussion summarizes observations and gives inferences
Generalization synthesizes key points in relation to objectives and hypothesis
Findings can be applied to daily life, such as soap behavior in salt water and fresh water
